application: Retained original-author provenance for the weighted differential-form operators used by SG and FTC. SOM derives conditional score moments, the complete second-energy bounds and original source errors directly. No additional author-source reading claimed.

owner_review.coverage: SOM1–SOM24: actual conditional score moments of every even order, exponential tail, correlated multiplier estimate with derivative cost, complete weighted score/Hessian identity, original staple force, full second-energy matrix trace with the shared local deficit, and exact source-vector norm limit including all removed-star and half-edge errors.
owner_review.strengthening: Uniform conditional moment control replaces a pointwise supremum in the full score/Hessian contraction. Every outside Hessian row remains. The actual finite second-energy matrix now has an evaluated trace budget, and its original source norm has a positive evaluated limit after retaining its exact lattice-spacing power.
owner_review.limitations: The trace-only physical filter estimate has order a_j to the sixth power, weaker than FTC12. The source-directed inverse, both physical residuals and the signed three-scale response remain unevaluated. The interacting continuum state, reconstruction, global smoothness, theory identification and no-gap endpoint remain unproved.
owner_review.actual_reading: SOM derivation read in full. BM1–BM6, BM13–BM17; SG1–SG19; FTC21–FTC31 read directly. Original-author provenance and previous bounded PT reading retained; no new source reading inferred from index hits.

diagnostics.scope: Radius-two analytic one- and two-sphere diagnostics, correlated multiplier inequalities, original trace constants, exact face/edge sampling and removed-star bounds. Analytic diagnostic densities and arbitrary bounded face means are not the original Yang-Mills vacuum.

owner_review.status: Complete proof and local reader checks accepted; remote verification recorded separately.
